name: TEMC
old_description: At TEMC, we are your premier partner for high-end sensors for high-purity fluids in the Semiconductor and Life Sciences industries. Our story begins with a commitment to offer only premier UHP sensors. Together, TemTech and GEMS Company bring a diverse selection of pressure and temperature sensors. Electrpolished SS/ Hastelloy/ PTFE and PFA wetted surfaces are available for most applications. TemTech and GEMS Company have proven historical records in Semiconductor installations globally. Their products encompass high-temperature pressure sensors and a complimentary selection of accessories.
about:
TEMC operates from Reno, Nevada, serving as a dedicated partner for high-purity fluid sensing solutions. The company was established to address the stringent sensor requirements of the semiconductor and life sciences sectors, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm supplies a range of pressure and temperature sensors designed for ultra-high-purity (UHP) applications. Its offerings include high-temperature pressure sensors and complementary accessories, with wetted surfaces available in electropolished stainless steel, Hastelloy, PTFE, and PFA. TEMC collaborates with TemTech and GEMS Company, leveraging their established product lines for global semiconductor installations.

Primary customers operate in the semiconductor and life sciences industries, where contamination control and process stability are critical. The company references proven historical records in semiconductor installations worldwide, indicating a focus on large-scale fab and research facilities.

TEMC differentiates itself through a commitment to premier UHP sensors and the availability of specialized wetted materials suited for aggressive chemical environments. The partnership model with TemTech and GEMS provides access to a diverse sensor portfolio backed by global installation experience.
